arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test R3: Brace validation with various patterns

# Valid: escaped braces
p1 = parse.Parser('{{literal}}')
r1 = p1.parse('literal')
print(f'Escaped braces work: {r1}')

# Valid: mixed escaped and unescaped
p2 = parse.Parser('{{start}} {name} {{end}}')
r2 = p2.parse('start John end')
print(f'Mixed braces work: {r2.named}')

# Invalid: unmatched opening brace
try:
    p3 = parse.Parser('{name extra')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Unmatched {{ raises ValueError: OK')

# Invalid: unmatched closing brace  
try:
    p4 = parse.Parser('text }')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Unmatched }} raises ValueError: OK')

# Invalid: nested braces without proper structure
try:
    p5 = parse.Parser('{{name}} extra')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'Nested braces issue raises ValueError: OK')

# Valid: simple pattern
p6 = parse.Parser('{name}')
r6 = p6.parse('John')
print(f'Simple pattern works: {r6.named}')

# Valid: multiple fields
p7 = parse.Parser('{first} {last}')
r7 = p7.parse('John Doe')
print(f'Multiple fields work: {r7.named}')

print('\\nAll R3 tests passed!')
"
